data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE tier). ROOT_CAUSE confirmed (high confidence): Push-retry loop retries at fixed ~2s cadence with no backoff/jitter, no SHA-progress assertion after rebase, and git fetch stdout swallowed (2>/dev/null || true) — so a concurrent writer at comparable cadence wins every race. All 5 hypotheses confirmed. Proposed fix: exponential backoff+jitter, SHA-progress detection with explicit fetch, per-attempt push_stderr logging, max_retries→5. Apply to BOTH inbound-bridge.yml and outbound-bridge.yml. Pausing to resolve PR merge conflicts first.
